interfaces: agent orchestrate help | init | prepare | select | run | watch | resume | status | next | publish | ready | rework | recover
Versioned driver profile, intake, session, diagnostic, response and receipt records under .agent/driver
Unchanged immutable manual packet/result plus a versioned companion handoff

behavioralConstraints: Complete staged task records must pass the registry and dependency/context checks and be present in a committed source before assignment
File readiness requires two stable observations; accepted results and receipts are content bound
Manual waits consume no provider dispatch attempt; semantic results are immutable; successor attempts require legal rework
GitHub publication is explicit and scope checked; merge requires an exact repository PR and SHA host grant plus native gate acceptance
invariants: The driver coordinates and never writes authoritative lifecycle or review evidence directly
Every role preserves the owning gate's context and distinct actor policy
Session and transport identities do not substitute for authorization or judgment
examples: A dropped response advances the originally pending role only after the manual adapter accepts it
A lost merge response reconciles through BOOT-025
edgeCases: Malformed and stale drops retain the original pending packet
Administrative recovery requires observed hash and quiescence
Ready conversion cannot create a missing draft

expectations: The operator can complete the manual workflow through documented commands
Machine output preserves the existing CLI envelope
acceptedRanges: Versioned driver records 1.0.0 and unchanged manual packet/result records 1.0.0
requiredReachableRanges: Prepared, waiting, stopped and DONE with original request identity
Auditable rejected and reused input receipts
